summary:
I have found the issue and resolved it. The nginx configuration was proxying the `/api/` traffic to port 5001, but the Flask server in `app/server.py` runs on port 5000. 

I updated the `proxy_pass` setting in `/etc/nginx/sites-available/default` to point to `http://127.0.0.1:5000` and successfully ran `test.sh`, which now reports that all tests passed.
